page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. This KVM-based virtual machine features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core allocation. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance scoring 3075.37 and Geekbench text processing scoring 2483.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core and general CPU benchmarks, such as the PassMark CPU score of 7535.23 and stress-ng multi-core performance of 6150.88, fall into the average tier. However, the instance exhibits weaker performance in memory-intensive and multi-threaded tasks. Memory bandwidth read-only tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression fall into the bottom 25%, as do Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing benchmarks.

The hardware configuration presents a clear tradeoff between strong single-core execution and limited memory throughput. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core scaling, the instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or high-speed local storage. Supported instruction sets include AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration such as AES and SHA_NI. This profile is best suited for single-threaded processing, text processing, lightweight web serving, and basic computational tasks rather than memory-heavy databases or parallelized compilation.
